title: Bucket of Mud
description: Bucket of mud is a rich dessert, similar to kitty litter cake. This recipe is good for making and bringing to parties in a sand bucket with a shovel.
ingredients: 1 (18 ounce) package chocolate sandwich cookies (such as Oreo®)
2 (3.5 ounce) packages instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping (such as Cool Whip®), thawed

steps.text: Place sandwich cookies in a blender or the bowl of a food processor; pulse until finely ground. Set aside.
Pour milk into a bowl; whisk in pudding mix until no dry lumps remain. Set aside.

Beat cream cheese and margarine together in a bowl using an electric mixer until smooth; stir in pudding. Fold in cookie crumbs and whipped topping until evenly combined. Spoon into a clean plastic sand bucket; cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving.
